chapter: Sidemen, mixed bands, the Apollo and Lena Horne
title: Barney Kessel joins in Hollywood
summary: Barnet first worked with Kessel in Hollywood and took him to Hawaii in 1946.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: How about Barney Kessel? When did he work with you?

Oh, Barney, I first got mixed up with Barney out here in Hollywood. He went to Hawaii with us right after the war in '46, and he played -- we did dates around up and down the coast here and everything. He was in the band.
